detailZones.title: Reception desk
detailZones.description: Explore the curved reception counter, desktop equipment, drawer units, desk panels and visitor-facing edge.

detailZones.title: Entrance and visitor check-in
detailZones.description: Inspect the glass entry doors, mullions, floor mat, door hardware, check-in stand and entrance glazing.

detailZones.title: Access gates
detailZones.description: Explore the lobby turnstiles, glass flaps, card readers, steel posts and lane floor markers.

detailZones.title: Lifts and service core
detailZones.description: Inspect the lift doors, call panel, floor indicator, door track, lobby wall and surrounding finishes.

detailZones.title: Visitor waiting area
detailZones.description: Explore the visitor sofa, lounge chairs, coffee table, rug, indoor plant, coat stand and umbrella holder.

detailZones.title: Glazing and interior details
detailZones.description: Inspect the glazed facade, interior plant, ceiling lights, floor joints, bench seating and architectural finishes.

anchorAudit.rationale: The generated source and final JPEG were inspected at native and final pixels. This scene retains 150 independently pointable objects and visible parts across 6 bounded zones. People, identity, readable text, brands, hidden contents, inferred processes and unsupported states were excluded.
